heading: EXT. SCHOOL BUS, LAST DAY OF SUMMER CAMP - AFTERNOON

units.text: EXT. SCHOOL BUS, LAST DAY OF SUMMER CAMP - AFTERNOON
A yellow bus idles on a gravel lot, windows down, smelling of sunscreen and lake water.
Six kids pile in, damp-haired, loud.
MAYA, thirteen, drags her duffel up the steps and drops into the front seat, then immediately stands, looking down the aisle.
TOMASZ, fourteen, slouches behind her with headphones round his neck.
JOLENE and her twin ROSALIE, twelve, argue over a seat.
SPENCER, eleven, carries a jar with a frog in it.
And at the back, alone, HIROSHI, fourteen, sits with his knees up and a letter in his fist.
Everybody, quiet, I have to say something!
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Nobody wants you to say something.
units.name: TOMASZ

units.text: Shut up, Tomasz.
units.name: JOLENE

units.text: Always saying something.
units.name: ROSALIE

units.text: The frog's coming with me!
units.name: SPENCER

units.text: Spencer, no.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: He cradles the jar, plants himself in the aisle.
She sighs, turns to the whole bus, and takes a breath.
Hiroshi folds the letter into smaller and smaller squares, until he can't fold any more.
Tomasz notices.
He pulls his headphones up.
Jolene and Rosalie fall silent in the same instant.
The frog croaks.
I'm going to miss you all.
units.name: MAYA

units.text: Nobody laughs.
The bus lurches forward.
Hiroshi presses his forehead against the window and does not look back.
